one_liner: George Springer's .403 estimated wOBA on contact is fifth-best in this 485-batter pull, produced on a modest 83.4 mph average exit velocity.
three_things: .403 contact quality from an 83.4 mph average is the most counterintuitive line in this set.
The tail carries it: 104.6 mph at the 90th percentile.
context_note: Descriptive only, from a single 2025 Statcast pull (pitches_faced_2025>=300 floor, 485 of 671 batters). The contact numbers -- exit velocity and estimated wOBA on contact -- cover the batted balls only, not every pitch seen, and estimated wOBA on contact is a batted-ball model: it says nothing about walks, strikeouts, or actual results. This pull carries no swing/miss or launch-angle column, so there is no whiff rate and no barrel profile here. Not park-, role-, or opponent-adjusted, and not a prediction. League-wide ranks were computed by sorting all 485 batters in this manifest on the named field; every printed value is read verbatim. Estimated wOBA on contact rewards launch angle and direction as well as force; with no launch-angle column in this pull, the reason the model likes his contact so much is not identified here.
